meta.title: ARR is MRR × 12
meta.summary: SAMPLE $80k MRR → about $1M ARR. One-time fees are not MRR.

success.message:
Session complete. ARR ≈ MRR × 12. One-time is not MRR.

SAMPLE: $80k→~$1M; strip setup before you annualize.

start.message:
SAMPLE: $80k MRR. Someone says ARR.

Move?

choices.label: ARR is the same $80k, just yearly branding

wrong_start_x10.message:
×10 understates 20%. ARR is twelve months of MRR.

Return to ×12.

wrong_start_same.message:
ARR is the annualized run rate, not the monthly number relabeled.

Return to ×12.

onetime.message:
That $80k includes $10k of one-time setup this month.

MRR to annualize?

choices.label: MRR is $0 because of the contamination

wrong_onetime_keep.message:
MRR excludes one-time. Annualizing a setup fee pretends it repeats.

Revisit the strip.

wrong_onetime_zero.message:
Strip the $10k; $70k still recurs.

Revisit the strip.

wrong_check_1m.message:
100k×12=1.2M. $1M would be ~83k MRR.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_100k.message:
That is still monthly.

Try the check again.
